snapshot.description: Fix THCSTestLayout.tsx to pass `writingResult` prop to THCSQuestionRenderer when in review mode (isSubmitted). Also update THCSWritingRenderer.tsx to display "Graded by {teacherName}" when gradingTier === 'teacher-graded'.
